card.name: Auxiliary verbs before a passive or action verb
card.fires_on: Small helper words such as to, be, being, were, 'll and originally, right where a verb like published, sent, assigned or printed is expected next. Seen in general web text about sites, programs and records.

modes.label: Passive helpers
modes.description: Be, being or were that precede a past-participle verb describing something done to things.
modes.example: census forms will<< be>> sent to households.

modes.label: To and 'll before a verb
modes.description: The word to or 'll that leads into an action verb.
modes.example: We are excited<< to>> have you become part of our community of
